Unit 6 Study Guide: Ecology

Review everything on the Unit 6 test: the carbon cycle, abiotic and biotic factors, predators, prey, and biodiversity, population growth (with mark and recapture and Oh Deer!), ecological relationships, and food webs, the 10% rule, and energy pyramids (with the owl pellet lab).

How it works
